pages.title: Spark of Life
pages.text: A small bright point that is the moment chemistry crossed into biology - self-replication, metabolism and a boundary, all arriving at once. It flickers unsteadily. Holding it feels like holding a match that might become a forest.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Abiogenesis is the unsolved step. I put primordial soup, stellar plasma and the omega point in the Abiogenesis Crucible with telomerase, a minimal cell and quantum chlorophyll, and caught the instant it all started to copy itself.
